item.title: Dangerous hole in cycle lane, 30th July
item.description:
This hole in the cycle lane is very dangerous. The cycle lane is extremely busy/ crowded at peak times, and many are traveling at a fair speed. This hole is not only painful if your bike falls in it, but could knock a cyclist over into the path of oncoming fast cycle traffic. It is also INVISIBLE at night! This hole has been present since at least September 2024. Please fill this hole. Thank you.
